bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
